blurb:
Fall is one your favorite times of the season for whale watching in Monterey Bay, where Humpback whales feed non stop before their migration south. This 3-hour tour aboard ENOCEAN’s premium 6-passenger vessel offers an intimate experience for wildlife enthusiasts. With the ocean calming in the morning, you'll enjoy unobstructed views and comfortable space while searching for Humpbacks, Killer whales, dolphins, and more. Your knowledgeable captain will provide insights into the local ecosystem, enriching your adventure. Plus, if you don’t spot a whale, enjoy a complimentary return trip, ensuring an unforgettable outing.

- 3-hour whale watching tour on a premium 6-passenger vessel
- Guaranteed whale sighting or a complimentary return trip
- Expert captain/naturalist providing insights and answering questions
- Limited to 6 guests for a personal and immersive experience
-Professional photographer onboard taking photos for you
